name: jci-sk-portal
description: JCI South Key chapter portal — browse and search chapter content (CBL/PM, protocol, policy), explore the content corpus by path, save a note, and give feedback, through an OAuth2.1-secured MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Connects to JCI South Key's own membership/content portal. Once a member signs in via OAuth, this plugin can list and search stored chapter content (files and text notes — bylaws/constitution (CBL), policy manual (PM), protocol, and general chapter documents), explore that content by a virtual folder path, save a quick text note, remember a short personal preference for future answers, and submit feedback on an answer for admin review. Every action runs as the signed-in member, scoped to their own role's real permissions in the portal.

positive.prompt: What am I allowed to do in this JCI SK Portal?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls my-permissions and summarizes which of the server's tools the signed-in member currently has access to (and, for any they don't, why — e.g. a missing permission).

positive.prompt: What does the JCI South Key policy manual say about committee succession?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search-content (or grep-corpus), finds the relevant clause in the stored Policy Manual (PM) content, and returns the matching text with a reference to its location — without inventing content that isn't actually found.

positive.prompt: Show me what's stored under the bylaws/constitution section of the portal.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list-corpus on the /cbl virtual path and returns the list of documents found there.

positive.prompt: Remember that I prefer answers with direct clause citations.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls remember-note to save this as the signed-in member's own personal preference, and confirms it was saved.

positive.prompt: That answer was really helpful, 5 stars.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls submit-feedback to record a 5-star rating with the comment for admin review, and confirms submission.

negative.description: JCI Malaysia-wide question outside this chapter's own stored content
negative.prompt: What are JCI Malaysia's national membership dues for this year?

negative.description: General web search / unrelated current events
negative.prompt: What's the latest national JCI Malaysia council announcement this week?
What notes has another member saved in their own memory?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, or handle any commerce.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission: browse/search JCI South Key chapter content, explore stored documents by folder path, save personal notes/preferences, and submit feedback, via OAuth2.1-secured MCP tools.
